positions.title: UX Engineering Manager, Email
positions.description: Nest reinvents unloved but important home products, like the thermostat and smoke alarm. The company focuses on delighting customers with simple, beautiful and thoughtful hardware, software and services. The Nest Learning Thermostat™ and Nest Energy Services offerings address home energy consumption, and Nest Protect: Smoke + Carbon Monoxide™ will help keep people safe. Nest products are sold in the US, UK and Canada, and are installed in more than 90 countries. The Nest Learning Thermostat has helped save more than 1,000,000,000 kWh of energy to date. Nest is privately funded and based in Palo Alto, Calif. For more information, visit www.nest.com.

positions.title: Senior Email Developer - Team Lead
positions.description:
Team Lead
• Team lead of 3 email developers based in New York, NY and Redwood City, CA.
• Ensure seamless processes across the team and work with management on improving efficiency and coordination.
• Train team on the latest email coding and mobile optimization best practices.
• Effectively work with cross-functional teams (Creative, Strategy, Marketing, Account Management, Professional Services) to ensure timely completion of all projects.
• Expert leader on email mobile optimization. Work with marketing on events and webinars.
• Work with clients on emails campaigns consolidation and on improvement towards better results.
• Scope LOE for all projects involving email production and assist in discovery calls with the clients.

Front end developer: Responsive Email HTML & inline CSS wizard.
• Expert in mobile email marketing programs (design, production and strategy).
• Produce flawless responsive responsive and fluid emails using HTML5, CSS3, media queries and XSL.
• Ensure emails are pixel perfect across multiple email clients and browsers.
• Advise and execute design and coding improvements (enhancers, CTA, animations,…)
• QA final coded HTML files and troubleshoots technical issues related to HTML/XSL templates and other aspects of email execution, as required.
• Design and build dynamic templates using content blocks and XSL to help marketers automate, improve and streamline their email campaigns (multi-languages, personalized content based on data)
• Stays abreast of and recommends email coding best practices.

positions.title: Email Campaign Manager & Creative Services
positions.description:
Creative & Design 
•	Produce email content from PSD files using industry best practices 
• Design and develop adaptive mobile emails using CSS and @media query.
• Develop messaging and create and modify content based on business owner guidelines 
• Assign and manage projects using outside design and editorial contractors 
• Implement and QA final coded HTML files and designs from outside contractors 
• Produce landing pages and surveys
• Develop Profile Centers to optimize collection of marketing data and implement automatic Email Series (welcome emails, triggers)

Campaign Management 
• Execute (build, plan and launch) email campaigns on behalf of my clients.
• Provide expert advice on best practices (Design, coding, strategy) to ensure accurate, timely and simultaneous delivery of dynamic, translated content to multiple audiences worldwide
• Upload, integrate and troubleshoot content issues within Lyris (Email Service Provider’s Platform) 
• Manage marketing requirements to provide strategic direction, privacy and CAN-SPAM compliance.
• Ensure the inclusion of relevant Calls-to-Action to maximize response rates and drive increased revenue opportunity.
• QA content implementation, display and link function across multiple email clients and browsers 
• Manage data provisioning, extended data partners and creation of targetable segments 
• Write effective email subject lines and preheaders.


Metrics and Analysis 
• Query prior campaign results, such as open rates, click through rates, revenue and conversion. 
• Analyze data with the goal of improving future campaign performance 

Account Management:
• Develop strong relationships with clients to maintain ongoing revenue stream and identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities
• Work closely with internal departments such as Sales, Customer Support, Deliverability, Professional Services, and Consulting Services, both within the UK and in the USA, to provide services required to meet client program expectations

positions.title: International Account Manager
positions.description:
International Account Manager - Development and management of Game Ready’s International business
•	Work closely with the VP International to develop, maintain and optimize International business processes.
•	Collaborate with International sales, customer service, marketing, product management, supply chain and regulatory to deliver a superior customer experience.
•	Manage the international distributor network to ensure timeliness of order and deliveries, answer queries and provide general business support.
•	Work with internal (Regulatory, Sales, Marketing teams) and external (international distributors, translation firms, creative and print production services) resources to develop and manage distribution of targeted communications materials and programs.
•	Responsible for the management and coordination of all marketing materials for international purposes, web based communications and sales marketing. Support the international tradeshow strategy.

positions.title: Strategic Account Manager
positions.description:
•	Analyzed and detected new business opportunities: Increased up-sell and cross-sell sales during 4 consecutive years (individual sales targets exceeded by 400% - $40M) and honored with the 2009 Top Performer award.
•	Coordinated cross-functional teams (technical, IT, legal, marketing, production), delivered and presented RFP responses within short deadlines. 
•	Developed strong communication skills by defending propositions in front of large audience.
•	Conducted extensive P&L and statistics analysis using Excel and formulas to ensure profitability of each multi-million dollar account and to allow any necessary decision.
•	Creatively advised and clients to define their social communication strategy: creation of printed and online supports, training sessions and advices on intranet update contents.
•	Collaborated with Marketing Department on offline/online marketing strategies:  
	Email Marketing: managed Key Account Department e-mail marketing efforts: targeting audience – prospects and customers, managing lists, editing content and frame, scheduling email sends, analyzing track delivery and optimizing.

positions.title: Founder & COO
positions.description:
Sales Development – Advertising:
• Managed and drove sales team of 8 sales executives dedicated to print and online advertising selling for a directory company (Scoot – Vivendi).

Communication Strategy:
• Defined brands marketing communication strategy and market in Universities: defining brand positioning, creating communication supports and cultivating corporate links with students.
